riskClassification.prohibited.subliminal: Does the system deploy subliminal, manipulative, or deceptive techniques to distort behavior?
riskClassification.prohibited.vulnerability: Does the system exploit vulnerabilities due to age, disability, or socio-economic situation?
riskClassification.prohibited.socialScoring: Does the system perform social scoring by public authorities?
riskClassification.prohibited.crimePrediction: Does the system predict criminal offenses based solely on profiling or personality traits?
riskClassification.prohibited.facialScraping: Does the system create facial recognition databases via untargeted scraping?
riskClassification.prohibited.emotionInference: Does the system infer emotions in workplace or educational contexts (without medical/safety reasons)?
riskClassification.prohibited.biometricCategorization: Does the system perform biometric categorization to infer sensitive attributes (race, political opinion, etc.)?
riskClassification.prohibited.realTimeBiometric: Does the system use real-time remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces for law enforcement?
riskClassification.prohibited.autonomousWeapons: Does the system operate as a fully autonomous lethal weapons system?
riskClassification.prohibited.denialEssentialServices: Does the system make fully automated decisions denying essential services without human review?
riskClassification.euAnnexIII.biometrics: Biometric identification and categorization of natural persons

riskClassification.euAnnexIII.employment: Employment, worker management, and access to self-employment
riskClassification.euAnnexIII.essentialServices: Access to essential private/public services and benefits
riskClassification.euAnnexIII.lawEnforcement: Law enforcement (risk assessment, polygraphs, evidence evaluation)
riskClassification.euAnnexIII.migration: Migration, asylum, and border control management
riskClassification.euAnnexIII.justice: Administration of justice and democratic processes

riskClassification.limitedRisk.syntheticContent: System generates synthetic audio, image, video, or text content
